summary: Frontend e2e coverage completed for the photoedit.in editor workspace.

issues: The fixed 900x600 canvas is clipped horizontally at 390px; the editor remains usable but the canvas is not fully viewable without horizontal scrolling.

action_items: Implement redo history behavior; the redo button currently has no onClick/state behavior.
Wire the File/Edit/Image/Layer/Filter/View menu buttons or clearly mark them unavailable.
Consider responsive canvas scaling or controlled horizontal scrolling on mobile.
critical_code_review_comments: redo-button is rendered without an onClick handler, so redo cannot restore an undone history entry.
History is only displayed inline; the History tab does not switch panels and menu buttons do not open menus despite being interactive controls.
seed_data_creation: None; used the existing sample image and a transient invalid test upload named TEST_upload.png.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Workspace load, branding, canvas, toolbar, zoom, layer add/select, adjustments, grayscale filter, undo, upload selection, PNG download, and mobile visibility passed. Recheck redo, menu actions, History tab behavior, and mobile canvas presentation after fixes.
rca of the issue: Static review shows redo-button has no handler and no redo state, while menu/tab buttons have no handlers/state transitions. Mobile CSS forces .canvas-wrap to 900px with transform scale(.7), which still exceeds the 390px viewport and clips the canvas.
